answer_2.quote: We evaluate the level of fluency and content diversity of the generated content by the models ... The former is measured through perplexity with an external GPT-2 model, while the latter is the density of distinct n-grams ... We also calculate the mean Euclidean distance of all the linguistic flags ... and report classifier accuracy.
